text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — exec dry run for Acme next Wed, want to make sure slides + asks are locked and demo owners ready.
dan_product: Thanks, Maria. I updated the slide with the requested ROI numbers, can someone proof the wording? link: https://drive.redwood/AcmeQBR
jess_onboarding: I'll take onboarding health + migration blockers slide. Current status: 65% of accounts migrated, 4 blocked by firewall rules (ticket IDs in the doc).
sam_engineering: Pinged infra team about two perf regressions in the staging model. If we don't get fixes by EOD Tue, we should plan a fallback model for the demo.
maria_cs: Noted. Jess, can you call out the 4 firewall tickets as blockers and add owners? Also include mitigations we offered (config snippet + install window).
jess_onboarding: Added owners and mitigation steps. Owner list: Ahmed, Priya, and Kara. Also added a short runbook section: `if migration fails -> rollback to v0.9 -> notify support channel`.
dan_product: Exec asks: 1) commit to SLA for dedicated pool 2) confirm timeline for usage forecast 3) demo acceptance criteria. I put these as one-slide bullets.
olivia_exec: @maria_cs can you surface the renewal risk ladder (green/amber/red) — we need to show how we're de-risking their renewal this quarter. Keep it high level.
maria_cs: Done — created a 1-slide risk ladder with actions and owners. Listed short-term wins (dedicated capacity trial, cost-savings estimate, weekly sync).
sam_engineering: About the fallback model — propose `redwood-small-quant` for the demo path; it's 2x cheaper and stable on current infra. Will add perf numbers to the notes.
denote: deploy-bot: build 5832 completed for staging, no new errors reported. (automated)
maria_cs: Two action items for this thread: 1) finalize deck by Tue noon (owners: Dan + Jess) 2) run dry-run Wed 9:30am with exec watcher (Olivia). Anyone object to that cadence?
dan_product: Sounds good. I'll do a pass on language and handoff to Jess for content alignment Monday.
jess_onboarding: I can do the dry-run with Ahmed and Priya and record it for Olivia. Also will prepare a 2-min script for the demo owner.
maria_cs: Final ask: include a dedicated slide with customer feedback themes (latency, rollout docs, pricing predictability). Dan, can you add the bullet on pricing predictability?
dan_product: On it.
maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll update the action tracker and ping when the final deck link is up. :thumbsup:
